desc: Every recipe of Zess T.'s own tables (each one-ingredient and two-ingredient entry) through her own lookups, under all eight combinations of the recipe options (Paper Mario 64's, Paper Cut's, the Japanese release's), Paper Mario 64 linked: each gives the table's dish; only the four pairs Paper Mario 64's recipes take give its dish, and only with them on (4 pairs x the 4 combinations with them on: 16) (a player's report: with Paper Mario 64 linked and its recipes on, every recipe of the game's own gave a Mistake)
